 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. A new MLS Matchday is an hour away. Tomorrow, we have El Clsico between LAFC and LA Galaxy. Nevertheless, that's a discussion for another time. Now, we are focusing our minds on the Orlando City vs. New York City FC game.
 Currently, the Lions sit seventh in the Eastern Conference, five places above their opponents. This is largely due to Orlando City's strong performances and the quality of soccer they display, with Antoine Griezmann leading the way.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement On the other side, NYCFC head into this match with inconsistent results and several players' injuries.
 For that reason, it's important to understand that whether the Little Prince is available could have a significant impact on both the result and Orlando City's game plan.
 Is Antoine Griezmann playing tonight for Orlando City against New York City FC?
 Oct 14, 2026; Toronto, Ontario, CAN; Orlando City SC midfielder Antoine Griezmann (7) reacts to a play against Toronto FC during the first half at BMO Field. Mandatory Credit: John E. Sokolowski-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect
 At the start of the season, before Antoine Griezmann's arrival in the United States, Orlando City found themselves at the bottom of the Eastern Conference, struggling with poor performances. However, the veteran French World Cup champion's arrival sparked a dramatic turnaround for the team.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Since his arrival, although the initial period was challenging, Orlando City's fortunes have completely reversed. Today, the Lions boast a solid midfield and a lethal attack.
 Griezmann's talent has become essential to his teammates' success, making his presence on the field invaluable. As a result, the Little Prince is expected to start in today's match as Orlando City continues their push for a playoff spot.
 This season, the "Little Prince" has played 18 matches, recording 13 goals and six assists. However, the most remarkable aspect of the Frenchman's arrival is the drastic change he has brought to his team's confidence and overall performances on the field.
 Orlando City now has a completely different squad from the one we saw at the beginning of the year, showing a level of competitiveness they hadn't displayed in several seasons.
